property_summary: For any callee address, calling forward(...) returns (i.e. does not revert) exactly when the low-level call to that callee succeeds; the mutant flips that and will revert for at least some callee behaviours (e.g., a callee that reverts), causing the observed success boolean from try/catch to differ.
change_summary: Change the call to ignore the returned success and instead require false (force revert when original would succeed), flipping revert behavior.
